title: Ben's English Class
setting: A bright classroom in a school.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt)

sentences.en: Ben is a beginner in this English course.
sentences.zh: 本是这门英语课程的初学者。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) sits at a desk in a bright classroom with a new, unopened English book, looking a little unsure.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben with a new book in class; 'beginner' and 'course' can't really be shown.

sentences.en: His class has English at school every morning.
sentences.zh: 他们班每天早上在学校上英语课。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) sit with other children in a school classroom in the morning sun.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the class in the morning; 'every morning' and 'English' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Their teacher Kofi stands at the blackboard with chalk.
sentences.zh: 他们的老师科菲拿着粉笔站在黑板前。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) stands at a big clean blackboard holding a piece of white chalk.

sentences.en: Ben draws lines on paper with his ruler.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) draws straight lines on a white sheet of paper with a ruler.

sentences.en: Then he writes the new words in his notebook.
sentences.zh: 然后他把新单词写进笔记本。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) writes carefully in an open notebook on his desk.

sentences.en: Mia helps him study and spell the words.
sentences.zh: 米娅帮他学习和拼写这些单词。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) points at the notebook of Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and helps him, both smiling.

sentences.en: Ben wants to learn every word for the exam.
sentences.zh: 本想为考试学会每一个单词。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) reads his notebook with a serious face, a pile of exam papers lying face down on the teacher's desk.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben studying hard with exam papers nearby; 'wants to learn every word' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Kofi asks if anyone had a holiday in Rome.
sentences.zh: 科菲问有没有人去罗马度过假。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) holds up a big photo of the old Colosseum in Rome; Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) raises her hand happily.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Kofi with a photo of Rome and Mia raising her hand; the question itself can't be shown.
